summary.text: Natalie Zeleznikar is a Republican state representative from Minnesota House District 3B who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired nursing home administrator, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that her priorities include lower property taxes, fraud prevention and career and technical education.

paragraphs.text: Natalie Zeleznikar was born in Cambridge, Minnesota, graduated from St. Francis High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin, Eau Claire in 1991.
Her career experience includes working as a healthcare consultant, licensed nursing home administrator, entrepreneur and small business owner.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was a nursing home administrator for 30 years and retired in 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Children and Families Finance and Policy, Health Finance and Policy, Rules and Legislative Administration, and Workforce and Business Development Finance and Policy committees.
She said in the survey that she wrote and passed a bill ensuring patients can have a support person with them in hospitals and care facilities.
She said her campaign messages include lower property taxes, ending pathways for fraudulent companies to bill state medical assistance, and investing in trades and career technical education.
